passages.instinctively: The animal reacted ins__________, without a learned plan or conscious calculation.
passages.invasive: The report describes an inv_____ species that has spread into the area and caused harm.
passages.kaleidoscopic: The display was kal__________, with patterns and colors changing like those in a kaleidoscope.
passages.meditation: The daily med_______ session gives participants time for quiet, focused reflection.
passages.millennium: A mil_______ is a period of one thousand years.
passages.mobility: The transport plan aims to improve mob_____ by making it easier to move between places.
passages.negotiation: The two sides entered neg________ to discuss terms and try to reach an agreement.
passages.nutrient: The label identifies a nut_____, a substance needed for growth and normal body functions.
passages.paleontology: The scientist studies pal_________, using fossils to investigate life in the geological past.
passages.pendulum: The clock has a pen_____, a suspended weight that swings back and forth.

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete ins__________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：tinctively → instinctively。学習語：instinctively。「本能的に」。学習した計画や意識的な計算によらない反応です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete inv_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：asive → invasive。学習語：invasive。「侵入する・侵襲性の」。この文では移入先に広がり害を及ぼす外来種を修飾します。単に非在来であることだけでなく、害をもたらす点が含まれます。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete kal__________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：eidoscopic → kaleidoscopic。学習語：kaleidoscopic。「万華鏡のような・変幻自在の」。模様や色が多様に変わる様子です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete med_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：itation → meditation。学習語：meditation。「瞑想」。静かに意識を集中する時間です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete mil_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：lennium → millennium。学習語：millennium。「千年・千年間」。千年という時間の単位です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete mob_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ility → mobility。学習語：mobility。「移動性・可動性」。場所から場所へ移動しやすくすることです。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete neg________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：otiation → negotiation。学習語：negotiation。「交渉」。条件を話し合い、合意を目指す過程です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete nut_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：rient → nutrient。学習語：nutrient。「栄養素」。成長や体の働きに必要な物質です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete pal_________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：eontology → paleontology。学習語：paleontology。「古生物学」。化石から地質時代の生物を研究する分野です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete pen_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：dulum → pendulum。学習語：pendulum。「振り子」。つるされた重りが往復するものです。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete per______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：sonnel → personnel。学習語：personnel。「職員・人員」。組織で働く人々を集合的に指します。personal（個人的な）とは別語です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete pla______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：cement → placement。学習語：placement。「配置・就職の斡旋」。この文では部品を置く位置です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete por_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：trait → portrait。学習語：portrait。「肖像画」。人物を描いた作品です。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete pre________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：dictably → predictably。学習語：predictably。「予想どおりに・予測可能な形で」。予想していた結果になったことです。

questions.prompt: Vocabulary Day 18 · Words 31–45: complete pro_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：found → profound。学習語：profound。「深い・深遠な」。十分な思索が必要な根本的な問いです。
